text.html:
Matcha has evolved into a high-demand category across foodservice, retail, and hospitality channels. For distributors and foodservice suppliers, it offers a scalable, shelf-stable product with strong commercial potential.

‍Reliable wholesale matcha supports distribution success through:

Consistent quality & specifications – uniform color, taste, and performance across batches
Clean-label appeal – single-ingredient, plant-based, and easy to position in premium channels
Strong market demand – growing adoption in cafés, restaurants, and retail assortments
Logistics-friendly formats – available in 1kg bags or bulk packaging for efficient handling
Versatile applications – suitable for beverage service, culinary use, and B2B resale
